_readme: Central affiliate/referral config. Tiles reference a program by key; the renderer builds the URL. Set your real IDs in `id` once each program approves you — until then links render CLEAN (no tracking params) rather than broken. Never hand-write tracking params into tile data.
disclosure: Some links on this page are affiliate links. If you buy through them, The Future 24/7 may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Crowdfunding links earn us nothing — they are listed because the technology is interesting.
